During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was dispatched on a reconnaissance '''mission''' to [[Phelarion/Legends|Phelarion]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Unfortunately, her ship was picked up by an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] commanded by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], and a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] [[TIE pilot|pilot]] identified by the call-sign of [[ZG-35]] was dispatched to disable the vessel. Leia's copilot and fellow Rebel agent, [[Hume (Rebel)|Hume]], anticipating that they will not be able to escape capture, knocked Leia out before placing her on a [[gossamer glider]], and then sacrificed himself by blowing up the vessel.

Afterwards, she was then recruited as a servant for [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Thalassa Tarkin]], the widow of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], who had perished at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], adopting a false identity of Lerna, and was likewise tasked with helping organize the [[Thirteenth Imperial Diplomatic Conclave]]. While undercover, she tried to hide traces of her true affiliation to the Rebel Alliance long enough to send a distress signal to the Rebel Alliance requesting for her rescue. She eventually managed to accomplish this, also killing one of the servants [[Nardo]] and covering it up as an accident. Unfortunately, the transmission was also intercepted by Vader's Star Destroyer, prompting Vader to make an unexpected visit to the Diplomatic Conclave.

Two of the servants, [[Sparv]] and [[Calus]] later discovered the wreck of Leia's gossamer glider, and also killed a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] that discovered it to silence him. Afterwards, they dragged Leia out of the Diplomatic Conclave, as they realized that her disguise as "Lerna" was nearly uncovered. Upon spiriting her away, Vader deduced that "Lerna" was actually Leia and had his soldiers pursue after her. Using the mines for the [[Megonite moss/Legends|Megonite moss]] as a means to temporarily deter the pursuing Imperial forces, they eventually reached a docking bay, and after a firefight, were picked up by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] with the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].
